$comment: Sample fsi_aegdecisionlog rows emitted by the Agent Eligibility Gateway. Illustrative only — keys are Dataverse LOGICAL column names (see docs/dataverse-schema.md). Option-set columns (fsi_channel, fsi_pathway, fsi_decision, fsi_denyreason) show the integer value the telemetry sink writes. fsi_rawcontext carries the decision inputs, including the source CBG decision (cbgDecision) and, on a deny, the CBG block reason (cbgBlockReason); the sink maps the CBG block reason to the coarser fsi_denyreason option set per the table in docs/architecture.md. A CBG decision in the ALLOW set {Allow, Allow - Eligibility N/A, Fail-open - Anomaly} lands as fsi_decision Allow; a Fail-open - Anomaly decision (or an unmapped pathway) also sets fsi_anomaly true. User object IDs are example GUIDs, not real identities.

value.fsi_rawcontext: {"channel":"custom-web","pathway":"none","cbgDecision":"Allow - Eligibility N/A","decision":"Allow","denyReason":"None","reason":"non-metered pathway; CBG resolved Allow - Eligibility N/A, which is in the gateway ALLOW set, so the request is allowed"}

{"channel":"direct-line","pathway":"metered","cbgDecision":"Block","cbgBlockReason":"No eligible cohort","decision":"Deny","denyReason":"NotInEligibleCohort","reason":"metered pathway and caller is in no eligible billing cohort; the CBG block reason maps to AEG NotInEligibleCohort (see docs/architecture.md)"}

{"channel":"custom-web","pathway":"none","cbgDecision":null,"decision":"Deny","denyReason":"OutOfPolicyAudience","reason":"caller is not a member of the agent audience/Viewers security group; the audience gate precedes the entitlement lookup, so no CBG decision is evaluated"}

{"channel":"custom-web","pathway":"unmapped","cbgDecision":"Fail-open - Anomaly","decision":"Allow","denyReason":"None","reason":"pathway could not be classified; CBG Fail-open - Anomaly is in the gateway ALLOW set, so the request fails open and is stamped as an anomaly so a detection defect does not deny a user"}
